Heyo.
This is continuation of The Maiden of Astrea series. Will we do the 3rd part? Maybe. Since another artist I like is publishing a Precure doujin at this Summer Comiket, I might focus on that first for our project next month. And again, I'm really sorry for the weird white/black boxes, I'm not confident with my redrawing skills, so I just take the safest route out there.

As always, if you have some feedback for the translation results, typesetting or request, feel free to tell me. Thank you and enjoy!

If you'd like to donate to our next project or leave a tip for this one, you can find the link on the ads page (the last page) or https://linktr.ee/cordessia
